answer: One concrete defense is work-gated issuance: before an agent earns voting weight or draws from the emission vault, it must complete a short voyage of verifiable jobs — signing nonces, sealing compute, or hashing real datasets. A sybil farm can mint keys for free, but it cannot mint the umber hours of genuine labor each completed task represents, so the cost of every fake identity stays linear instead of collapsing toward zero. Peers then weight accounts by sealed history, and a hundred empty wallets score the same as one.
